meta.title: Model Access
meta.description: Bring your own free-tier accounts into DeepSeek Harness: log in once and the models of thirteen channels (CodeArts, CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy, LobsterAI, Qoder, TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon, MiniMax, ZCode, Gemini) appear in the picker, with a token dashboard, a per-request log and a local OpenAI-compatible gateway.
